text:
kevin: Support reported a customer seeing repeated 429s during an embeddings migration; aggressive context trimming made outputs unreadable. Our error-ref mentions fallbacks but lacks a concrete SDK pattern. Need a tiny snippet + a short runbook paragraph to add to the docs.

sarah: I can draft. JS + Python?

maya: Both please. Minimal pattern: detect 429, trim context, optionally downgrade model, retry with backoff. Keep it compact.

jordan: Add telemetry notes: use `retry_reason` and `fallback_model` tags so Console can surface fallbacks.

sarah: Python draft:
# on 429: trim context, fallback to smaller model, retry once
try:
    resp = client.generate(model="redwood-large-v1", prompt=long_prompt, max_tokens=1024)
except RateLimitError:
    client.metrics.increment("client.retry", tags={"retry_reason": "context_trim"})
    short_prompt = trim_context(long_prompt, keep_last_tokens=2048)
    resp = client.generate(model="redwood-small-v1", prompt=short_prompt, max_tokens=256)

kevin: Add a 1-paragraph tradeoff note about quality vs cost/latency and when not to auto-downgrade (sensitive content).

sarah: Added. Runbook bullets (5): reproduce minimal case, confirm 429s, try local trimming, add fallback snippet, monitor Console fallback rate.

jordan: Link to SDK `retry_reason` docs and the Console dashboard for `client.retry` once PR exists.

sarah: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/801 (contains Python+JS snippets, runbook, telemetry note).

docs-bot: Lint OK. Link scanner flagged a relative link to /old-error-ref  suggest /error-reference/429.

sarah: Fixed link and pushed update.

maya: After merge, add a one-line example in the migration guide: event `client.retry` with tags `retry_reason` and `fallback_model`.

kevin: LGTM. Approved after JS backoff example added.

sarah: Done, merged.

maya: I'll add a changelog entry: "Add 429+context-trim runbook and SDK fallback snippets (Python/JS)."

kevin: Thanks, closing the loop. If support sees more repros we'll iterate.
